name: Ambrosia Biker Gang
summary: Violent outlaw motorcycle club operating across rural Ambrosia and southern Leonida. Control illegal weapon and drug manufacturing operations in the Leonida wetlands.
description: The Ambrosia Biker Gang is a heavily armed outlaw MC with chapters across rural Leonida. They run methamphetamine labs, illegal gun manufacturing, and protection rackets throughout Ambrosia county. Their heavily fortified compound in the Ambrosia wetlands serves as the site of GTA VI's Stash House Raid mission. They are openly hostile to outside criminal operators, making them frequent adversaries of Lucia and Jason.
territory: Ambrosia County, Southern Leonida wetlands, rural highways
knownMembers: Multiple unnamed enforcers seen in trailers
